BillHeading.BriefDescription: Increasing defined benefit accrual for specified years of service in the state retirement systems.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to increasing defined benefit accrual for specified years of service in the state retirement systems; and amending RCW 41.32.760, 41.32.840, 41.35.400, 41.35.620, 41.40.620, and 41.40.790.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 41.32.760 and 1977 ex.s. c 293 s 3 are each amended to read as follows:Computation of the retirement allowance.
BillSection.P: (1) A member of the retirement system shall receive a retirement allowance equal to two percent of such member's average final compensation for each year of service.

P.TextRun: (2) For years of service earned after the effective date of this section, a member of the retirement system shall receive an additional one-half of one percent of such member's average final compensation for each year of service beyond 30 years.

AnnNote.NoteP: Effective date—Severability—Legislative direction and placement—Section headings—1977 ex.s. c 293: See notes following RCW 41.32.755.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 2. RCW 41.32.840 and 1996 c 39 s 4 are each amended to read as follows:Computation of the retirement allowance.
BillSection.P: (1)(a) A member of the retirement system shall receive a retirement allowance equal to one percent of such member's average final compensation for each service credit year.

P.TextRun: (b) For years of service earned after the effective date of this section, a member of the retirement system shall receive an additional one-half of one percent of such member's average final compensation for each year of service beyond 30 years.

BillSection.P: (2) The retirement allowance payable under RCW 41.32.875 to a member who separates after having completed at least twenty service credit years shall be increased by twenty-five one-hundredths of one percent, compounded for each month from the date of separation to the date that the retirement allowance commences.
